title: Apparatus and Method For Gripping and Releasing Objects

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripping apparatus that can be attached to robotic arms or vehicles, but it does not mention it being cordless, handheld, or having integrated battery power.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: As shown best in FIGS. 3A , 3 B, 4 C and 10 A, adapter flange 110 may include a gasket 112 configured to receive and secure an object gripper (not shown in FIGS. 1A through 4C ) for making
features.note: The reference mentions a 'gasket' for making contact with the object, which implies a sealing function. However, it does not explicitly state that this gasket is a 'flexible sealing lip' or part of a 'suction cup' that bounds a sealed region.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: The reference mentions a 'vacuum pump or blower' that provides suction, but it is not stated to be electric, mounted within the rigid body, or integrated into the device itself. It is implied to be an external component.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference discusses producing and reducing pressure gradient forces and adjusting suction, but it does not mention any pressure sensor for monitoring the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or mechanism to alert when the vacuum level falls to a certain threshold.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning threshold, let alone one defined relative to a load-release vacuum.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or its behavior regarding persistence.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention any integrated rechargeable battery for powering a vacuum pump. The vacuum pump is implied to be external.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not disclose any warning indicator or its placement on the rigid body.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes an apparatus that can be attached to robotic arms or vehicles and uses external vacuum and fluid supply. It is not described as a single-hand portable design with all components carried by the rigid body without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripping and releasing apparatus with an actuating system, which shares the broad technical area of the subject invention. However, it lacks key features such as being cordless, handheld, battery-powered, and having specific warning indicators related to vacuum level
